name: MedAssist symptom triage
summary: A hybrid triage assistant: a fine-tuned BioBERT classifier suggests likely conditions, while rule engines handle emergencies, mental-health crises, severity and specialty routing.
architecture: Intent detection (greeting, medicine query, crisis, symptoms)
Rule-based emergency check (runs before the model)

training_data.source: Synthetic symptom descriptions generated from symptom lists and sentence templates
training_data.note: No real patient data was used.

intended_use: Educational demo of an AI triage workflow. It is not a medical device and is not clinically validated.
limitations: Trained on synthetic text, so real-world accuracy is unknown until it is tested on independent data.
Covers a fixed list of conditions; anything outside it will be mapped to the closest one.
English only. Not tested for demographic fairness.
Explanations show what the classifier reacted to, not medical causation.
safety: Emergency patterns are detected by rules before the model runs.
Low-confidence predictions return a prompt to see a clinician instead of a diagnosis.
Every result carries a disclaimer to consult a qualified healthcare provider.
